dataset.name: Primary acral melanoma (Liang, 2017)
dataset.description: Independent acral melanoma cohort restricted to primary tumors with bulk RNA-seq and patient-level survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Acral melanoma is a biologically distinct, non-UV-associated melanoma subtype. Primary tumors are retained and metastatic specimens are excluded so expression precedes the recorded disease course.

metadata.curation_note: The source profile contains 36 RNA-seq samples from 33 patients. Restricting to source-labelled primary tumors yields 15 unique endpoint-complete patients; metastatic specimens are not used as baseline expression.

expression.label: DataHub-provided standardized expression
expression.source_unit: DataHub profile labelled FPKM; supplied values are standardized
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub profile is named FPKM, but the frozen values include negatives and gene-wise means near zero with standard deviations near one, so they cannot be untransformed FPKM. TRACE Explorer preserves the supplied standardized values without a second transform and exposes this caveat in every result.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Acral melanoma diagnosis as encoded by the source clinical record

endpoints.label: Disease-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Primary-disease baseline as encoded by the source clinical record
endpoints.event_definition: Disease recurrence or death as encoded by the source DFS status
